title: cymbopogon citriodorus
intro: Cymbopogon citriodorus, commonly known as lemon grass, is a tropical grass plant native to Asia and Australia, belonging to the Poaceae family. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic agent, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon citriodorus include its ability to calm the mind and body, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy, and its antimicrobial properties, which can help to fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include citral, geraniol, and limonene, which are responsible for its distinctive lemon-like aroma and its various health benefits.
